name: Diamond Ring Builder ‑ Jewelry
author: Keyideas Infotech Private Limited

sections.description:
Keyideas offers a powerful Ring Builder plugin for WooCommerce jewelry stores, enhancing customer engagement and boosting sales by up to 30%. This customizable tool supports multiple languages (English, French, Italian, German, Spanish) and global ring sizes. Transform your jewelry website with a seamless, interactive customization experience to stay ahead in online trends.

  1. Showcase 200,000+ Diamonds(lab-grown, natural and colored) and Gemstones.
  2. Easily integrate suppliers like Nivoda, RapNet, and VDB via CSV or API.
  3. Add the “Build Your Own Ring” feature, fully optimized for mobile devices.
  4. Utilize advanced diamond filtering options through our Ring Builder.
  5. Easily manage margins, discounts, and filters through our Feed Center.

Paid Feature

Our free plugin delivers excellent performance, but the paid version takes it to the next level, offering advanced tools to boost sales and conversions. Upgrade to the WooCommerce Ring Builder premium version and unlock powerful features:

  1. Feed Center Access
  2. Margin Control for Diamonds and Stones
  3. Strike-through Discount Setup
  4. Add Your Own Diamond & Stone Inventory
  5. Full Inventory Management

Pricing: $1,250 a year + a one-time setup fee of $550–$1,000 depending on your website.

Explore all features here: WooCommerce Ring Builder by Keyideas

External Services

This plugin relies on third-party services for certain functionality. Below are the services used:

  1. Sirv CDN (https://keyideas.sirv.com)

    • Purpose: Hosts images used in the admin email templates.
    • Privacy Policy: https://sirv.com/privacy/

  2. Loupe360 (https://loupe360.com)

    • Purpose: Provides diamond video URLs displayed on diamond detail pages.
    • Privacy Policy: https://loupe360.com/privacy-policy

  3. Brevo Conversations Widget (https://conversations-widget.brevo.com)

    • Purpose: Loads the JavaScript required for chat functionality.
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.brevo.com/legal/privacypolicy/

  4. Engagement Ring Builder API (https://engagement-ring-builder-o4hk8.kinsta.app/api)

    • Purpose: Fetches product recommendations, diamonds, and ring data via API endpoints.
    • Terms of Service: https://engagement-ring-builder-o4hk8.kinsta.app/terms-of-service
    • Privacy Policy: https://engagement-ring-builder-o4hk8.kinsta.app/privacy-policy

  5. YouTube (https://www.youtube.com)

    • Purpose: Embeds tutorial and informational videos in the admin interface.
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  6. GeoPlugin API (http://www.geoplugin.net/json.gp)

    • Purpose: Retrieves user location data based on IP to provide localized content.
    • Privacy Policy: http://www.geoplugin.com/privacy

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries:

  1. Numeral.js
    • Version: 2.0.6
    • Description: A javascript library for formatting and manipulating numbers.
    • Source: https://github.com/adamwdraper/Numeral-js
    • License: MIT
